$comment: Published, versioned anchors for the Mist Index. Changing any value here requires bumping anchorsVersion AND re-publishing every historical score under the new anchors, clearly labelled -- silently re-anchoring is the metric equivalent of rewriting history. scripts/test-mist-index.mjs asserts each axis returns exactly these values at these points, so an edit here fails the suite until the tests are updated deliberately.

A1.name: surface
A1.measure: distinct name@version in package-lock.json, excluding workspace links

A2.name: install-execution
A2.measure: packages declaring preinstall, install or postinstall

A3.name: import-time reach
A3.measure: packages performing network or filesystem access at import

A4.name: churn
A4.measure: mean over merged PRs in the trailing 90 days

A5.name: red-state
A5.measure: mean over the trailing 180 days; LOWER is worse, so this axis is inverted
